messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT — Org 'BlueHorizon' exceeded org QPS threshold (observed 3.6x baseline). Auto-rate-limit policy TRIGGERED and soft-throttle applied (30m). See: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1788802468

sara_oncall: Oncall taking. Confirming impact: which routes are spiking?

mike_sre: /v1/generate and /v1/chat primarily. 95th percentile token latency rising, backlog on serving pools.

sara_oncall: ack. Can we do a targeted org RL bump to give them headroom while we triage? auto-throttle is causing 429s for legit traffic.

raj_eng: We can temporarily raise org rate from 200 r/s -> 650 r/s for 15m and enable graceful shedding on non-critical long-generation routes. Recommend not changing global quotas.

ellie_cs: CS on call — BlueHorizon says their critical checkout feature is failing for some users. They asked for ETA. I can message them if we have a quick mitigation.

sara_oncall: Good. Please tell them we're investigating and doing a targeted limit increase to reduce 429s. I'll coordinate.

mike_sre: Quick safety checks before override:
```
# verify org config
redwoodctl org get bluehorizon --fields=rate_limit,quota
# check active sessions
redwoodctl sessions list --org bluehorizon | wc -l
```
Output: rate_limit=200 r/s, active_sessions=312

sara_oncall: runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/org-rate-override - following step 2 (temp bump + monitor).

raj_eng: I'll apply the temp bump now with a 15m TTL. Command: 
```
redwoodctl org set-rate bluehorizon --rate 650 --ttl 15m --reason "emergency spike: reduce 429s"
```

deploy-bot: action: org-rate-update started for bluehorizon by raj_eng at 2026-03-17T15:07:12Z

deply-bot: (typo placeholder)

deploy-bot: action: org-rate-update succeeded — new rate 650 r/s (ttl 15m).

mike_sre: Confirming metrics backfill. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/serving/bluehorizon-qps
sara_oncall: Monitoring p95 latency and 429 count.

(2m later)

mike_sre: 429s dropped from 180/min -> 12/min. Latency p95 down 40%. CPU on pool stable.

sara_oncall: Excellent. Elllie, pls update customer: we applied a temporary increase and are returning them to normal once burst subsides.

ellie_cs: Sent: "We applied a short-term traffic increase to prevent failures and are monitoring closely. If you still see errors please reply here." :thumbsup:

raj_eng: While we have headroom, I'll disable a non-essential heavy-generation feature flag for BlueHorizon to reduce long-tail token churn: 
```
feature toggle off long_completion_for_org bluehorizon --reason "reduce token churn during spike"
```

deploy-bot: feature-toggle update: long_completion_for_org (bluehorizon) -> OFF.

mike_sre: Good call. We'll keep the TTL on the rate bump and re-evaluate at T+12m. If stable, let it expire; if not, escalate to capacity.

sara_oncall: safety note: Created an incident ticket INC-2026-3387 and assigned to eng-sre for postmortem. Action items: (1) CS customer notify (done), (2) observe metrics, (3) rollback config after TTL, (4) collect request traces for offending endpoints.

ellie_cs: BlueHorizon responded: "Thanks — errors dropped after your change. Please advise on root cause." They've asked for a postmortem.

(10m later)

mike_sre: Metrics stable. 429s ~5/min, p95 latency within SLO. No further user reports.

sara_oncall: letting TTL expire in 4m. If all good at T+15m, we'll close this thread and add remediation items to INC-2026-3387.

(15m after initial)
deply-bot: action: org-rate-update TTL expired for bluehorizon — rate reverted to 200 r/s

mike_sre: Post-change check: slight uptick to ~22 429/min immediately after revert but within acceptable window; we'll follow up with traffic shaping rules for next deploy.

sara_oncall: Closing short-term mitigation. Next steps in ticket: add per-route soft-shedding, recommend customer to add client-side backoff, investigate unusual request patterns that caused spike.

ellie_cs: Noted — told customer we'll share postmortem when ready. Thanks team. :heart:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — BlueHorizon org spike mitigated. Duration: 00:21:18. Linked ticket: INC-2026-3387
